page.overview:
Who is Benjamin Cole?

Benjamin Cole is a human book merchant operating in Vasselheim. As an NPC, is played by Matthew Mercer.

Benjamin is quite wry, and no-nonsense. He seems to take his job, and the hobby of book collecting, very seriously.

Benjamin is an employee of a bookstore in Vasselheim.

While looking for information on the Raven Queen, Vex'ahlia met Benjamin while attempting to read a book without buying it. He insisted that she purchase the book if she were to read it, and upon realizing that she had no intention of doing so, took the book from her and declared that there would be no sale. Vex caved and paid full price, giving Benjamin the honor of being the first person to ever make Vex pay full price.
